label: Residential water use
unit: gallons per capita per day (residential potable)
description: System-level residential potable gallons per capita per day (GPCD) for the town's retail culinary water system, 2022 data. Potable only: towns with separate pressurized-irrigation (secondary) water (e.g. Lehi, Saratoga Springs) look low. Approximate system matches where the town has no own system: west-valley-city->Granger-Hunter Improvement District; millcreek->Salt Lake City Water System; cottonwood-heights->Jordan Valley Water Conservancy District (Retail); holladay->Holliday Water Co..
source: Utah Division of Water Resources, Municipal & Industrial Water Use 2022
